intro.summary: Northwest community beside McMahon Stadium and the Banff Trail CTrain station, mostly single-detached homes with growing semi-detached infill.
intro.body: Banff Trail is next to McMahon Stadium and the Banff Trail CTrain station, between Crowchild Trail and the University of Calgary area. Most of its homes are mid-century single-detached houses. Its location near transit and the university has made semi-detached infill and small multi-unit projects increasingly common.
